content:
SECTION 1  
* A 24-year-old agrees with Sajid Javid that it’s unfair to blame young people for spending some money on normal things like holidays or meals out.  
* Older people often say millennials should save every penny for a house, but the writer thinks this ignores how difficult buying a home has become.  
* The writer says house prices are rising, homes are harder to find, and banks are less willing to give mortgages, so owning a home may never happen for them.  
* They feel many young people will be stuck renting forever, paying landlords while being criticised as “irresponsible.”  
* Another person adds that under-25s don’t get the full “national living wage,” so they can be paid much less than older workers for the same job and are also more likely to have insecure work like zero-hours contracts.
